chapters.title: Backstage Pass
chapters.html:
The distant, muffled sounds of her crowds of fans winding down and leaving the stadium was the only thing Mydei could hear deep backstage as she took a breather alongside her bandmates. They all chatted amongst themselves while waiting for crowds to disperse but they always remembered to give Mydei a few extra minutes to herself before striking up conversation, as well as offering a pat on the back for another show well done as she came down from being front and centre of the entire set. It had been there biggest show yet.

She leaned up against the wall, tucking her leather jacket over her shoulders more as the chill of the evening picked itself up — though the lower neck of her shirt leaving the top half of her chest exposed still felt unaffected — and pulled out her phone to browse what she’d missed during the performance. Besides the usual notifications from social media, a text caught her eye in the sea of pop-ups on her lock screen.

Mom: Good luck with your band tonight, not like you need it. I know you’ll wow the crowd like you always do. Make sure to fill me in tomorrow. Love you always. x

While she was still too exhausted to shift the muscles of her face just yet, on the inside Mydei smiled dearly at her mother’s words of support. While she could still perform her best with or without it, she never took her mother’s messages for granted and they were always a good pick-me-up after a long show.

Her small moment of serenity would soon be disturbed as their manager approached and made his way past her bandmates.

“Hey, miss lioness-of-rock, don’t forget you have the photo op in a few with the competition winner,” her manager informed as he walked closer. “Don’t get too comfortable there, you need to be ready for a fan interaction. You can have your downtime afterwards.”

Mydei growled a sigh in frustration. Shit, I forgot about the photo op... “Okay, boss. I’ll be at the back door shortly,” she said as she shoved her phone back into her pocket. “It’s just the one fan, right? Not multiple winners or a group of friends?”

“Yeah, just the one so don’t sweat it. Give a signature smile, give ‘em a few words and then you’re home free for the night.”

Just one fan interaction was doable, she supposed. It wasn’t that she wasn’t thankful for her fans, she was always grateful for their support but interacting so soon after the show was not ideal in her mind. She just hoped the fan in question wasn’t about to ask her a hundred and one questions or talk her ear off in overwhelming excitement.

“We’ll be there, off to the side if you need us, De,” offered Leo, one of her fellow bandmates. The rest of them gave a quick nod in assurance and she gave a very subtle smile in return, with what her weary lips could offer.

Their manager motioned with a head tilt to begin their walk to the doors to backstage so she and her bandmates followed unhurriedly to meeting spot.

Once outside, they spotted a member of security guiding someone towards them who was clearly not dressed for staff duties. As they moved closer, Mydei could make out a woman with strikingly white, short hair, glasses resting on her face and hands fidgeting somewhat nervously together as she followed the security guard. Their manager wandered over to meet them, likely about to relay the dos and don’ts.

“Hey, swear I’ve seen that girl before…” one of her bandmates spoke up from behind her. Truth was, Mydei was wondering the same. As the fan got closer, things were starting to click together in her brain.

Memories flashed through her head from all the concerts she can remember at that moment. A head of white present in every crowd she performed for, sometimes banners above that same head declaring their love for her music and on occasion, even her, herself. Sometimes, it was just her standing alone in the crowd clutching where her heart is with eyes that seem to sparkle, other times she had companions with her, raising their arms up high alongside her, cheering Mydei’s name with so much chest and energy as they all wore the biggest smiles, though none shone so radiant as the white-haired girl as her glasses reflected back the stage lights like a beacon directing her attention to her number one fan.

“That’s because she’s the hot cutie that is at every one of our shows,” said Mydei as a grin grew across her face. “What a stroke of luck she’s the competition winner.”

A collection of ahs and hms sounded from her band in understanding before one of them wandered to her side and swung an arm around her shoulders. “Guess you won’t be needing us after all. We’ll all go and grab some after show drinks from down the road so feel free to use the dressing room to wind down after, yeah?” Heph said with a quick wink. A couple of snickers could be heard from the group behind them.

“Are you sure you guys don’t want to introduce yourselves as well, get a band photo for her as a bonus?” asked Mydei.

“Ehh, use that as an excuse to ask her if she wants to meet up again,” replied Heph with a mild smirk as she gave Mydei’s shoulder a quick pat before returning her arm and rejoining group. “Come on, girls! Drinks are on Perdi since she was the last on stage tonight.”

Complaints and laughter could be heard as Mydei watched her bandmates retreat from the area, leaving her to return her attention to the approaching, number one fan whose eyes seemed to grow wider the closer she got to the rocker. The security guard stopped a short distance away, watching with a sharp eye, allowing her manager to walk the woman the rest of the way to Mydei.

“Mydei, this is Phainon,” her manager gestured to the competition winner. “Seems like she’s quite the fan, very lucky to have won this opportunity so let’s show her a good time!”

Oh, we can do that alright.

Now with the woman up close, Mydei could get a proper look at her and she found herself immediately drawn to the her vivid blue eyes almost glowing with, what she swore was a hint of gold. Phainon gazed at her so wide with interest and she guessed disbelief, being so close to what was probably a star in her eyes.

“Phainon, hm? Cute name. It’s nice to meet such a big fan,” said Mydei with a hint of smile. The other woman’s shoulders jumped at the comment.

“O-oh, thanks,” Phainon responded with a voice finding it’s feet, still looking a little like a deer in the headlights.

“C’mon then, girls, let’s get these pictures. I’m sure we’ve all got places to be,” rushed Mydei’s manager as he shifted through his bag to grab a camera. Mydei rolled her eyes at his haste, a little disappointed with his lack of manners in front of someone seemingly lost in excitement.

“Not really,” both women replied almost in a perfect harmony. The two shot each other a look in surprise then their expressions began to crack as the beginnings of laughter hissed and whistled past lips resisting to part and curved in amusement, keeping the sound contained to snickers.

As her manager fiddled through the camera settings, Mydei decided to try and break the ice a little more. “So, I noticed you seem to be at every show I can recall. You like my band’s stuff that much, hm?”

“Oh gods, you noticed that!?” Phainon gave her cheek a slightly nervous scratch with a single, sheepish finger. “I’m not sure if I should feel embarrassed or not…”

“Why should you? It feels nice to see someone likes our stuff that much they make the effort to attend every gig and concert we do. You’ve probably been to more of our gigs then some of own members.”

“Oh, that reminds me!” Phainon sprung to life from her embarrassment to look at Mydei with a more eager expression. “How’s Hephaestion? I noticed she had to miss your last few shows, is she okay? I was so happy to see you all on stage tonight but it being her first night back on the stage since, I’m a little worried for her.”

Mydei found herself blinking at the woman, a little taken aback by her seemingly genuine concern for her friend and fellow bandmate. She was so used to the focus being on her — their biggest star, lead guitarist as well as vocalist and nearly everyone’s favourite member — she felt a little touched to see a fan show concern for the others in her band. Seems I’ve found a real one.

“I can assure you have nothing to worry about,” replied Mydei with the beginnings of a smile. “Heph’s gone for after show drinks with the others still full of spirit. It’s like nothing ever happened to her.”

“Oh! That’s a relief.” Phainon returned the small smile with one of her own.

“Alright, ladies, I got this thing ready now so enough yappin’ and show me your best poses!” The manager brought the camera up and level with their face, signalling with his freehand to get ready.

The women shared a quick look before they shuffled themselves closer to one another, Mydei noticing Phainon’s nerves were starting to rise again. Extending an arm around her fan’s shoulders, she pulled Phainon closer, their heads rested against each other and the catch in Phainon’s breath not going unnoticed by the rockstar’s ears. She grinned at the sound as she looked to the camera.

Click went the camera and another for good measure. Her manager gave a quick look at the miniature screen before bring the camera back in front of his face. “Okay, let’s do one more shot and call it a night.”

Mydei peered through the corner of her vision to see Phainon still posing a little stiffly beside her though from what she could notice, her face was radiating with such glee to be where she was. As her manager’s fingers flexed towards the shutter button, Mydei pushed down on Phainon’s shoulders with the arm wrapped around them and directed Phainon’s face towards her chest. Her cheek found itself pressed right against the exposed half of Mydei’s breasts and a squeak of surprise escaped her, causing Mydei to smirk and laugh from the throat.

Click. “Really, Mydei?” questioned her manager with an eyebrow raised at the star.

“We need to show the number one fan my appreciation, I would hate to send her home underwhelmed and disappointed,” Mydei replied as she loosened the arm around Phainon, chuckling to herself again as the woman remained resting against her chest, completely unmoving. Her manager simply rolled his eyes, muttering a few quiet words to himself as he shut the camera off and returned it to it’s bag.

Finally, Phainon seemed to snap back to reality as she lifted her head back up and stammered a little as if her brain was scrambling itself back together after being positively flustered by the unexpected move from her idol. Oh, I could do this all night with her, Mydei thought to herself, her lips still curved in a pleased grin. I want to see more… hear more…

“I was actually hoping to ask if you wouldn’t mind taking one with my phone too,” Phainon finally let out, her expression hopefully pleading towards Mydei’s manager. “If that’s okay?”

“Sorry, no time, kiddo. Our lioness here needs her—”

“We can take a few on her phone, I’m in no hurry.”

The manager stopped all motion for a brief moment before looking Mydei’s way, his face, once again, staring at her in puzzlement. “Aren’t you itching to wind down after the show tonight?”

“She’s won her chance to be here and I think she deserves a bit more time.”

Resting a hand behind Mydei’s shoulder, her manager guided the both of them a couple steps away from her fan and he leaned in to whisper, their backs to Phainon. “Mydei, we can’t afford to be having you get into scandals with fans and—”

“Do you think I’m a fool? I know to take care around fans,” Mydei whispered back.

“Mydei…” grumbled her manager.

“If it makes you feel any better, Heph gave her approval.”

Her manager could only sigh, knowing he couldn’t argue the judgement of her friend, known to all of them for being the sharpest when it comes to reading anyone and everyone.

“It’s stars like yourself, miss rock chick, that can lead me to taking blood pressure pills for the rest of my days and an early retirement.” He gave a stern look in Mydei’s direction.

“As if you weren’t planning on an early retirement anyway,” she casually grumbled in return.

With another roll of his eyes, her manager leaned away and began to take his leave.

“I’ve got work to be doing before I can retire to my bed so you two can do whatever you want without me.” He shot a quick glance to Phainon. “Don’t be getting any bright ideas, missy,” he warned before walking away, taking the security guard still on watch with him.

Mydei returned to Phainon’s side. “Don’t worry about him,” she said. “The last band he managed tried to live the harder style of rock and roll life. They probably gave him a lifetime’s worth of stress and anxiety.”

“Yikes,” commented Phainon. “Are you sure you’re not too exhausted though? It’s already been a great time to get a couple pictures and I’d hate to—”

“You want these selfies or not?” Mydei interrupted.

“Y-Yes, of course! Sorry…” Her number one fan frantically reached to grab her phone from the pocket of her jacket. Mydei laughed at her messy haste to which Phainon narrowed her eyes at her. “What’s so funny?” she asked.

“I’m sorry, Phainon,” Mydei replied while snickering through her words. “You’re just too fun to get a reaction out of.”

“Huh!?” was Phainon’s response, an edge of heat to her tone which stopped Mydei in her tracks. “Is this how you treat all your fans?”

“No, of course not!”

“Do you enjoy teasing them knowing they’re too starstruck to say no and proceed to shove their faces into your boobs too!?” Phainon’s tone was continuing to pick up in hostility, clearly riled up by her idol’s teasing.

Mydei scoffed. “Absolutely not. While I’m always grateful for my fans, most interactions are tiring so I keep them brief. With your pretty face and fun reactions, I can’t help but want to play more, my apologies.” She allowed a small, playful smile back onto her face. “Besides, think of that last photo as payback for when you flashed yours at me. I think you yelled out something about signing them too?”

“…Fuck.” Phainon’s face dropped back into embarrassment. “You remember that!? Gods, I want to dig myself a hole and disappear into it. I-I’m so sorry about that time, I had a lot of pre-show drinks with my friends and—”

Mydei cut her off as she burst into laughter. “Don’t worry about it. We all thought it was highly amusing. Besides, they’re nice tits so I have no complaints.”

“Oh my gods. Mydei!” Phainon’s hand moved to cover her face while Mydei could only laugh harder.

Eventually, as her hand lowered, Mydei found herself faced with eyes that look at her like a puppy would look to it’s human for something it really wanted.

“Then…,” Phainon began. “You wouldn’t mind — maybe — signing them for me for real? Right now?” There was edge of of something sultry to her voice as she spoke, and Mydei found herself caught in it immediately. The woman’s confidence had made it’s way out and the rockstar was hooked. “Maybe I can get you back for your teasing too. You wouldn’t want to leave a fan disappointed now, right?”

“Ha!” Mydei burst out. “You’re absolutely right, I cannot do that to such a loyal fan.” She motioned with her fist and thumb sticking out towards a direction away from the back area of the stadium. “It would be indecent to have me sign them out here but the dressing room is free — it can also lock out any unwanted attention.”

A sly smile appeared upon Phainon’s face. “Then I’ll make sure to tell you how much I love your music while we’re there, how much the lyrics you write mean to me and I’d love to hear you sing some more just for me — your most loyal fan.” Her voice was much closer to a seductive tune, the hint of gold in her eyes glinted with something captivating and Mydei felt a fire burn within. She may be the singer between the two of them but Phainon’s words were calling to her like a siren’s song.

“Tell me— Show me everything, my dear, number one fan,” she replied with her own allure. “You’ve got me now, so take me — I’m all yours.”

Mydei may have rocked the crowds of the stadium that evening with her music, but she had a feeling Phainon was about to rock her night with whatever was stirring within that stunning head of hers as she watched her expression shift with her confidence that excited Mydei for what awaited her.
